assistant.title: {{assistantName}}
assistant.incognitoHint: Deleted after 24 hours and never used to learn about you.
assistant.noConversations: No conversations yet. Start one to talk to {{assistantName}}.
assistant.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This can't be undone.
assistant.emptyMessages: No messages in this conversation yet.
assistant.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.composerQueueHint: {{assistantName}} is working — anything you send now is answered next.
assistant.queuedNotice: Sent — {{assistantName}} will answer it after the current reply.
assistant.approvalTitle: {{assistantName}} needs your OK before going ahead
assistant.noMemories: Nothing yet. Tell me about yourself and I'll remember.
assistant.permissionsHint: Choose what {{assistantName}} may do on its own, what it should ask about first, and what it should never do.
assistant.contextOf: {{used}} of {{window}} tokens (estimate). Older messages are summarized automatically.
assistant.recording: Listening… tap the mic again to stop.
assistant.personalizationHint: How {{assistantName}} writes to you and lays out answers. It also learns from your feedback — every change is kept here.

styleHints.design: Bullets, tables, headings, what comes first.

stylePlaceholders.design:
- Lead with a one-line summary
- Use tables for comparisons

assistant.noSituations: Nothing needs you right now. Situations from your Daily report show up here.
assistant.reportInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Customer emails first. Skip GitHub bot notifications.
assistant.dailyOff: {{assistantDaily}} is off. Turn it on in settings, or run one now.
assistant.prepOff: {{assistantPrep}} is off — you can still prepare any meeting below.
assistant.prepManual: Automatic prep is off — use Prepare now.
assistant.connectCalendar: Connect Google Calendar to see your upcoming meetings.
assistant.noMeetings: No meetings with guests in the next 7 days.
assistant.inboxIntro: {{assistantInbox}} labels new email as it arrives in your Gmail or Outlook, moves the noise out of your inbox, and drafts replies for you to review. It never sends anything.
assistant.inboxConnectGmail: Connect Gmail or Outlook to use it.
assistant.inboxEmpty: New email will show up here as it arrives.
assistant.labelsHint: Describe each label the way you'd explain it to a new assistant. Mail moves out of your inbox only when every label it gets says "Move out".
assistant.newLabelDefinition: When should this label be applied?

draftModes.confident: When confident — otherwise suggest one here

assistant.knownSendersOnly: Only draft for people I've emailed or my own domain
assistant.skipExistingLabels: Leave mail I've already labelled alone
assistant.draftingInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Sign off with my first name. Never commit to dates.
assistant.channelsEmailHint: Email or CC this address from your account email.
assistant.channelsSlackHint: DM {{assistantName}} in Slack. Reply in the thread to keep going, !stop to stop, !link for the chat here.
assistant.channelsSlackFailedNotice: Couldn't connect Slack. Please try again.
assistant.knowledgeHint: {{assistantName}} searches your private knowledge and the workspace's shared knowledge base. Add notes, files, pages and synced apps there.
assistant.channelsSmsHint: Text {{assistantName}} at {{number}} from your verified phone. Text !stop to stop a reply.
assistant.channelsSmsNeedsPlan: Texting needs a plan that includes it.
assistant.noTriggers: Nothing scheduled. Ask {{assistantName}} to do something every morning, or add one here.
assistant.triggerWebhook: Runs when its URL is called
assistant.triggerPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Summarise my unread email and flag anything urgent.
assistant.triggerPromptWebhook: e.g. A new lead came in: {{payload}} — add them to my list.
assistant.webhookHint: After you create it you'll get a URL. Anything POSTed to it is passed to {{assistantName}} where you write {{payload}}. Treat the URL like a password.
